answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats block fakes. Each agent stakes 10 units and sends a heartbeat of fresh work; a beacon audits 5% per round. A relic credential replayed from an old session fails the heartbeat, and a tundra of clones fails because audits demand new work, not copies. Forging 1,000 identities costs 10,000 units plus 1,000 heartbeats. An honest agent pays once, keeps undiluted rewards, and a marble log strips cheaters of deposits.
